name: normail-agent-relay
description: A small relay you run in your own Cloudflare account. Normail calls it when your Claude agent has work, and it starts the agent with a token that never leaves your account.

NORMAIL_SIGNING_SECRET.description: The signing secret. Normail shows it to you once, on the screen where you set up the relay. Copy it from there and paste it here.

CLAUDE_TRIGGER_URL.description: The trigger address of your Claude scheduled task. In Claude, open the task, open its API trigger, and copy the address. It starts with https://api.anthropic.com/v1/claude_code/routines/ and ends with /fire.

CLAUDE_TRIGGER_TOKEN.description: The trigger token of your Claude scheduled task. It is shown next to the address on the task's API trigger and starts with sk-ant-oat01-. Normail never sees this token; only your Cloudflare account holds it.
